title: Parser Generator — Bison
description: GNU parser generator for LALR grammars.
body:
1. Tool identity. This record is the public-edition reference for Bison, a parser generator. GNU parser generator for LALR grammars. Category: Languages and Code Management.

2. Actual implementation. A working implementation ships inside this record as executable JavaScript (demo.program) and was executed in Node.js; the verified output is stored in demo.output. The demonstration exercises the tool's core behavior: [Bison] grammar 'expr: term (('+'|'-') term)*' -> LALR(1), 0 conflicts.
